lucy: Nightly eval anomaly for v2.1.0 — fail rate up +6.8% on 'customer_faq' slice vs v2.0.3. Lots of truncated answers and stray end tokens. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/eval/1771234567

sasha: Can you paste a couple failing examples and IDs? Is this billing_faq only or broader?

lucy: Mostly multi-turn FAQs and a few legal prompts. Two samples below (ids included). Noting some odd token output like '<|eot|>' mid-answer and missing final sentence.

lucy: ```
ID: 2345
PROMPT: "How do I update my billing address for my account?"
EXPECTED: "To update your billing address, go to Settings > Billing and edit the address on file. Save changes and you'll receive a confirmation email."
ACTUAL v2.1.0: "To update your billing address, go to Settings > Billing. <|eot|>"

ID: 2391
PROMPT: "Do I need to pay tax for subscriptions in EU?"
EXPECTED: "Tax requirements depend on your country; generally VAT applies..."
ACTUAL v2.1.0: "Yes. You are responsible for taxes."  <-- overly terse, drops qualifiers and citations.
```

kevin: I ran a quick local decode compare. With v2.0.3 the model completes fine. v2.1.0 shows a big spike on the end token logit mid-sequence. Not just quantized runs — float32 reproduces too.

omar: Reproduced locally. Looks like tokenizer normalization changed in v2.1.0 (it strips zero-width spaces and merges ligatures). That shifts token offsets which in turn misaligns the KV cache prefix positions for some multi-turn prompts. Suspect kv-cache alignment bug when tokenizer alters byte offsets.

ci-bot: Nightly job finished: eval run at 2026-03-19T00:00Z. Regression threshold exceeded on 14 sub-slices. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/1771234567/

kevin: Quick logit diff for ID 2345: v2.0.3 top probs -> ['the', 'invoice', 'is'] ; v2.1.0 top probs -> ['the', '<|eot|>', 'invoice'] — end token probability jumps mid-sequence.

omar: Command I'm using to reproduce:```bash
# reproduce locally
python eval/run_eval.py --model redwood/v2.1.0 --prompts data/customer_faq.json --seed 42 --export outputs/1771234567
```

sasha: Propose actions: 1) Pin hosted/dedicated rollout to v2.0.3, 2) Omar to triage tokenizer config, 3) Kevin to run weight-diff & ablation (is it tokenizer-only or weight+tokenizer interaction?), 4) Add failing examples to nightly golden set.

lucy: Agree. I'll open a blocking PR to pin tokenizer config and add a small unit test that ensures no mid-answer end-token spikes on golden prompts. Label: regressions/v2.1.0. ETA 24h.

kevin: Also add a quick ablation: run v2.1.0 with old tokenizer mapping (if possible) to verify whether weights alone cause the spike. If weights + old tokenizer reproduce, it's a weights issue; if not, it's tokenizer-induced cache misalignment.

sasha: I'll add the failing IDs to the failset and create an alert rule for >3% delta on multi-turn FAQ slice.

lucy: Thanks — assigning owners: omar (tokenizer triage), kevin (weight diffs/ablation), sasha (eval suite + alerting). We'll sync tomorrow 10:30am PST.

kevin: One more note — check quantization toolchain too; even though float32 shows the issue, quantization could exacerbate the end-token spike in prod. Add quantized runs to the ablation matrix.

omar: On it. I'll start with tokenizer config rollback locally and verify kv-cache alignment. Will post repro diffs here.

lucy: :thumbsup: Great. If we confirm tokenizer is root cause, we should include a migration path for token offset changes to avoid KV misalignment for in-production cache states.

ci-bot: Action items created: TICKET-ML-589 (tokenizer triage), TICKET-ML-590 (weight-diff/ablation), TICKET-ML-591 (nightly-failset update).

lucy: Closing for now. Keep examples coming if you find new patterns.
